name: aardjon/trad.ota
description: Server backend of the trad route database online updater

scripts.build: cd src && cp ../composer.lock composer.lock && jq '"Version " + .version' ../composer.json > version.txt && jq '.autoload."psr-4"."trad\\"="." | . + {config: {"vendor-dir": ".vendor"}}' ../composer.json > composer.json && composer install --no-dev -o -a && rm composer.* && mkdir -p ../artifacts && cp -r . ../artifacts/ota
